entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 월경 중인 경우는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and women during menstruation must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not have intercourse or wash with irritating soap during the treatment period. If you forget to use this medicine, do not make up the dose; simply apply the next dose. Use this medicine locally only, and after applying it to the oral mucosa or the gums, rinse the mouth thoroughly. This medicine is strongly acidic, so be careful that it does not get into the eyes; if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water and then consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.질 세균 감염 환자는 용액을 적신 거즈를 질 안에 넣고, 가벼운 압력으로: For patients with a bacterial vaginal infection, place gauze soaked in the solution into the vagina and press the affected area with light pressure for 1 to 3 minutes. Use it twice at intervals of 3 to 4 days. For patients with stomatitis and gingivitis, apply it repeatedly several times using a soaked cotton swab or similar.
